subject: Launch readiness alignment and risk triage — cross-functional sign-off
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning on launch readiness — final triage

Team —

As we move into the final week before the public pilot, I want one consolidated pass across GTM, enablement, pricing, docs, and support so we can surface any residual risks and owners. Please see the attached enablement-deck-v2.pdf and pricing-summary.xlsx for the current state.

Quick ask by EOD Tue (9/22):
- GTM (Markus): confirm staging traffic plan + contingency cutover window.
- Enablement (Laura): confirm trainer schedule and recorded demo checklist.
- Pricing (Kimberly): confirm final SKU naming and any promo that needs legal sign-off.
- Docs (Monica): confirm public docs publish date and known doc gaps.
- Support (Karthik): confirm on-call coverage, escalation playbook, and runbook delivery.

Risk notes I have right now: we still don't have a support runbook early draft and there are two pricing edge cases (partner credits + reserved capacity) that need language before we ship marketing assets.

Can each owner reply with a one-line status and a single blocker (if any)? I'll consolidate and share a triage in the Marketo kickoff thread on Wed.

Thanks —
Marissa
---
Marissa Cole | Director, GTM Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning on launch readiness — final triage

Marissa — thanks for the callout. Quick status from enablement/docs: 

- Enablement: Trainer roster confirmed (2 live sessions + 4 office hours). Recording setup is validated with infra team; we need the final demo script by 9/24 to avoid last-minute re-records. Blocker: demo script has a pending pricing example that depends on Kimberly's SKU names.
- Docs: Docs publish window is set for 9/28. Monica will push the landing page, but we have three API examples that are placeholder content. Monica — can you confirm whether those are code samples from the engineering draft or if we should ship placeholders with a clear TODO?

Support runbook: Karthik, I know you were pulling a template — if we can get a draft (even bullets) by 9/24, CS can run a tabletop with the on-call roster. If you need help populating the incident steps I can have two enablement SMEs assist the morning of 9/25.

Laura

From: Jordan Reeves <jordan@acme.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Support <support@acme.io>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning on launch readiness — final triage

Hi team — this is Jordan on behalf of ACME Corp (pilot customer). Appreciate the heads-up and the detailed asks. A couple notes from our side: 

- We can commit to a reduced set of test traffic for the first 72 hours; please provide the exact endpoint and token scope so our SREs can configure the test harness.
- Our support team would like to validate the escalation window and expected response SLAs for Sev2/Sev3 during the pilot (we need this by 9/26 to align our internal postmortem cadence).

Attachments from our side: sample-integration-logs.txt (I included minimal logs to help you replicate a warm-up pattern).

Let me know who from Redwood is the single point for escalation during the pilot — we'll add them to our incident bridge.

Thanks,
Jordan Reeves
Director, Platform Engineering — ACME Corp
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Reeves <jordan@acme.io>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Launch readiness — final decisions, owners, and sign-offs (see actions)

Thanks for the updates. Consolidated decisions after triage: 

1) Support runbook: Karthik will own and post the initial draft (support-runbook-draft.md) by EOD 9/24. CS tabletop scheduled 9/25 10:00am PT with Laura and two enablement SMEs.
2) Pricing SKU naming: Kimberly to confirm final names and promo language by 9/25 COB; marketing placeholder copy will use provisional SKUs until legal signs off.
3) Demo script: Laura to deliver the final demo script by 9/24 5pm PT — enablement will record on 9/25 morning.
4) Docs publish: Monica to publish landing + API examples on 9/28; placeholder callouts ok but mark as TODO.
5) Pilot escalation: Markus is the primary single point of contact for ACME (add markus_klein@redwood.com to the incident bridge). Sev2 response target: 30 minutes; Sev3 target: 4 hours for pilot window. Jordan, confirm if those targets work for ACME by EOD 9/26.

Open risks: pricing edge-case language for partner credits still outstanding — Kimberly mark as high-priority and loop Legal if not closed by 9/25.

Action items (owners):
- Karthik: support-runbook-draft.md (due 2026-09-24) — attachment referenced.
- Kimberly: pricing-summary.xlsx final (due 2026-09-25).
- Laura: demo script + recordings (due 2026-09-24/25).
- Monica: docs publish (due 2026-09-28).
- Markus: incident bridge + SLA note to ACME (due 2026-09-26).

I also uploaded a DocuSign link for the pilot SLA if ACME is ready: https://www.docusign.com/s/LAUNCH-SLA-ACME-2026 — please review the SLA section on reserved capacity and incident credits before sign-off. Requesting final internal sign-off (all owners) by 2026-09-30 so marketing can kick off promotional materials the week of 10/4.

If there are any last-minute red flags, reply all with the word "HOLD" and the single-sentence rationale. Otherwise I'll close the triage and update the launch board.

—Markus
Markus Klein | VP, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
